entry.idea: Designing new products in factories takes a lot of slow, manual work, so AIONA built an AI agent called REVY that helps engineers do that design work faster.
entry.lesson: Automate the slow, document-heavy steps of an expert job while keeping a human in charge of the final decision.
entry.name: AIONA

growth.reason: No user, revenue or customer numbers are available yet.

market.reason: Manufacturing companies worldwide need design and engineering work done, a large but specialized market.

tech.reason: It uses AI on a company's own design documents and know-how, a solid approach that a strong team could rebuild in a year or so.

sources.title: 設計業務を自動化するAIエージェント「REVY」のAIONA、ON&BOARDリードで1.4億円を調達

entry.twist: REVY reads a company's own past drawings, documents and unwritten know-how to prepare each design decision, such as spotting failure risks or checking drawings for errors, but leaves the final call to a human engineer.
entry.who_pays: Manufacturing companies pay to speed up and support their engineers' design and drawing-check work.
entry.why_now: AI agents are now good enough to read technical drawings and documents, work that used to need a specialist engineer's judgment.

mentions.snippet: AIONA Corporation, based in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo and founded October 10, 2024, raised 140 million yen via J-KISS stock acquisition rights and debt financing, led by ON&BOARD with GxPartners, Crest Skill Partners, and Mizuho Capital participating. Funds go toward REVY, its AI agent for automating design tasks in manufacturing.
